text.Mercenary Garrison:
How to play ==
Mercenary Garrison is an unaligned Outpost with defense 5. For every colour of which you have an ally in play, you get an effect. However, it has no abilities without any allies, and (since it is unaligned) also does not provide any allies for other cards. 
 Strategy ==
This card is not very good in early game since you will often not have any allies, and hence it will just be a dead outpost (for which something like a Battle Station is better). In mid-game it can be useful, especially if you have a rainbow deck that is quite well scrapped, so that you trigger multiple abilities every turn. It can be particularly effective to accelerate cleaning your deck. In late game it is usually not particularly strong anymore, since none of its ally abilities really stand out then, although it can still be good if it stays in play multiple turns.
